reasons.reader_question: Clear: why hasn't Rohan seized the medicine he knows about, and what will binding to him cost?
reasons.change: She goes from crew leader to the last survivor, roped to her hunter. He knows about the medicine, and she owes him her life.
reasons.romance_movement: There are three new reasons: a life debt, his handing over command, and her first free truth. The romance is still missing his response to that truth.
reasons.shown_chemistry: He breaks spacing to stay near her, says 'Where you told me...', and his thumb brushes her wrist. All of it is shown through action, not narration.
reasons.character_logic: Both leads act smart overall. Meera's 'I'll go on' contradicts the rule that a lone crosser dies within an hour.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: The odds are stated, the loss is irreversible, and her silence and her truth each cost her leverage.
reasons.prose: The rib-holding gesture repeats five times, once oddly before the injury. One AI tell ('In that moment'). The final line is flat.
reasons.continuity: Consistent with the bible and with F066 to F071 and F315 to F319. Goats, ribs, bell, note and tent poles all match.

fixes: Before the slide, the line 'one hand pressed to his side. When she looked again' shows Rohan holding his ribs before he is hurt. This is a continuity glitch. Cut it. Later, vary the four repeats ('good hand pressed to his side', 'hand pressed to his ribs', 'A hand held his side') into one held side plus different tells: the shallow breath, the slow sit, the arm kept low.

At the cairn, 'I'll go on and I won't be able to stop' implies Meera could cross alone. That contradicts the world rule that a lone crosser loses the path within an hour, and the failure mode is irrational behaviour. Rewrite as: 'You stand here till the cold finishes you, and I lose the line inside the hour. Two dead instead of none.' This makes the shared stake explicit.

After 'Because my brother is dying there', the disclosure gets no response from Rohan, so the intimacy ladder is incomplete (technique 10, chemistry worksheet). Before the closing lines, add one specific action from Rohan that shows he understood. For example, he turns his face up the lit line and says only 'Then we go,' and steps into her footprint unasked. Replace 'Nothing in the world would take it back' with a sharper image.
reader_question: Rohan knows she carries medicine and has not taken it, so what does he want, and what will the bond cost two people who could hang each other?
new_facts_assessment: All five facts are necessary and consistent. Moving the redbark to her pack plants its survival fairly. Rohan closing the spacing sets up the rescue. The medicine question sharpens chapter 4. The archive's partial rule fits the wardens' buried knowledge. The stones dropping half a note on a truth is new and unlisted, so log it beside F081.
